results.description: Another quality eBook from Chapel Library. This issue of the Free Grace Broadcaster includes the following: The New Birth Defined by William Plumer (1802-1880). The Spirit That Breathes Life by Octavius Winslow (1808-1878). The Necessity of the New Birth by Arthur W. Pink (1886-1952). Biblical Terms for the New Birth by John Gill (1697-1771). New Birth, Repentance, and Faith by James Buchanan (1804–1870). New Birth, New Creature by Octavius Winslow (1808-1878). The Marks of the New Birth by J. C. Ryle (1816-1900). The Eternal and Efficient Cause of the New Birth by John Gill (1697-1771). The New Birth and the Preacher’s Obligation by John Owen (1616-1683). The Necessity of the Spirit’s Work by Charles H. Spurgeon (1834-1892).
